skill.name: gaffa-support
skill.description: Troubleshoot gaffa skills using conversation context and live documentation, then prepare a locally saved, redacted support report for manual review and email.
skill.summary: Resolve gaffa skill problems or prepare a local support report without calling the gaffa API.
skill.author: gaffaai

security_audit.summary: All 63 static alerts are false positives involving Markdown, API reference text, expected documentation access, or credential safeguards. One semantic finding covers incomplete redaction before reports are saved and displayed. No evidence found of malicious exfiltration or prompt injection; support reports require manual review and sending.

remediation.issue: Best-effort report redaction can miss hard-coded secrets, URL tokens, and personal data before disk writes and inline display.
remediation.suggestion: Expand secret detection to URL tokens and script literals, minimize personal data, and require approval of sanitized artifact previews before saving or displaying reports.

remediation.issue: Exact-value credential scrubbing is skipped when the API key does not meet the stated entropy floor.
remediation.suggestion: Do not silently retain known credential values; block report creation or require explicit review when safe exact-value scrubbing cannot be applied.

content.user_title: Troubleshoot Gaffa Skills and Prepare Support Reports
content.value_statement: Gaffa skill failures can leave developers without a clear diagnosis or useful support evidence. This skill checks live documentation and prepares a local report for review.
actual_capabilities: Attempts one bounded diagnosis using the current conversation and live gaffa documentation.
Searches documentation through MCP, with HTTP fallback and explicit timeout limits.
Collects gaffa reasoning logs, relevant generated scripts, and developer-provided request IDs.
Lists discovered artifacts and lets the developer exclude items before report creation.
Applies credential-redaction guidance and saves a timestamped Markdown report through an atomic write.
Displays the report for review and provides the support address for manual email.
limitations: Does not call the gaffa API, execute failing browser requests, or send support reports automatically.
Redaction is best-effort and can miss script literals, URL tokens, and personal data.
Conversation compaction can remove earlier context; reports depend on available context and local artifacts.
Live troubleshooting depends on documentation access; unavailable documentation leads directly to report preparation.

use_cases.title: Diagnose a Gaffa Skill Failure
use_cases.description: Check current documentation against a failed skill workflow and receive a likely cause with a concrete next step.

use_cases.title: Package Reproduction Evidence
use_cases.description: Gather relevant scripts, reasoning logs, and request IDs into a reviewed report without submitting another browser request.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Support Handoff
use_cases.description: Summarize unresolved problems and prior troubleshooting in a local report that can be reviewed before contacting support.

prompt_templates.title: Describe a Problem
prompt_templates.prompt: Use gaffa-support to help with this problem: [what I tried and what failed]. Check the documentation and suggest one next step.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: start with a short problem statement

prompt_templates.title: Check an Error
prompt_templates.prompt: Use gaffa-support to compare [error message] with current documentation. Explain the likely cause without calling the gaffa API.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Local Report
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a gaffa support report for [problem]. List relevant logs, [script filename], and [request IDs]. Let me exclude artifacts before writing.

prompt_templates.title: Review Sensitive Evidence
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a gaffa report from [artifacts]. Review URL tokens, script literals, and personal data. Flag redaction uncertainty and keep sending manual.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: review reports with sensitive artifacts

output_examples.input: My extraction fails on a large page. Help without submitting another request.
output: Likely cause: the extraction input may be too large.
Suggested next step: narrow the selected page region or set an input token cap.
No gaffa API request was submitted.

output_examples.input: The problem remains unresolved. Prepare a report using my diagnostic log and generated script.
output: The report summarizes the problem, environment, prior troubleshooting, and two selected artifacts.
Credential fields were redacted, but script literals, URL tokens, and personal data still require review.
The timestamped Markdown report is saved in the working directory and shown for review.
After reviewing, email the file manually to support@gaffa.dev.

best_practices: Provide a short problem statement, the skill involved, and relevant request IDs.
Exclude unrelated artifacts and review the report for secrets, URL tokens, and personal data before sending.
Delete reports after use or exclude them from version control.
anti_patterns: Treating best-effort redaction as a guarantee that every secret has been removed.
Expecting the skill to rerun browser requests or email reports automatically.
Assuming conversation details remain available after context compaction.

faq.question: Does this skill call the gaffa API?
faq.answer: No. It reads documentation and works with conversation context and local artifacts without submitting gaffa API requests.

faq.question: Does troubleshooting spend gaffa credits?
faq.answer: The support workflow makes no gaffa API calls, so it does not spend gaffa credits.

faq.question: Where is the report saved?
faq.answer: A timestamped gaffa-support Markdown report is saved in the current working directory and displayed for review.

faq.question: Is the report sent automatically?
faq.answer: No. You review the report and email it manually to support@gaffa.dev.

faq.question: Does redaction remove every secret?
faq.answer: No. Redaction can miss script literals, URL tokens, and personal data. Review the report before sharing it.

faq.question: What happens if documentation is unavailable?
faq.answer: The skill reports the documentation failure and continues preparing a support report from available context and local artifacts.
